download_models: download docling ML models to a local directory with configurable model selection and force/progress options
download_layout_model: download the layout model for document structure analysis using LayoutModel.download_models
download_table_structure_models: download TableFormer and TableFormerV2 models for table structure extraction
download_ocr_models: download RapidOCR and EasyOCR models for Chinese and English text recognition
download_vlm_models: download vision-language models including SmolVlm, GraniteDocling, and SmolDocling for picture description
